conventions.units: meters for all 3D quantities; angles in radians (degrees duplicated under 'extended')
conventions.forward_F: unit vector out of the face, detected from the mesh (MPFB faces world -Y)
conventions.image_right_R_img: camera +X axis in world space; image right is the SUBJECT'S LEFT
conventions.eye_labels: L/R are the subject's own left/right eye; the left eye appears on image right
conventions.h_v: h > 0 moves the pupils toward image right, v > 0 moves them up; inputs clamped to [-1, 1]
conventions.eye_midpoint_M: midpoint of the two least-squares-fitted eyeball centers
conventions.camera: location M + 0.40*F, looking exactly at M, up = U; never moves
conventions.sequence: theta_k = 2*pi*k/10, h = sin(theta_k), v = cos(theta_k); k = 0 is straight up, then clockwise as seen in the image
conventions.pixel_coordinates: origin at the image top-left corner, x right, y down, pixel (i, j) center at (j + 0.5, i + 0.5) (OpenCV-style continuous coordinates)
conventions.camera_matrix: 3x4 P = K [R | t], OpenCV convention (camera +X right, +Y down, +Z forward); K, R, t also under extended
conventions.eye_rotation: world-frame Euler angles (Blender 'XYZ': R = Rz @ Ry @ Rx), radians, of the eyeball rotation relative to its rest pose (optical axis along F); quaternion (w, x, y, z) under extended
conventions.pupil_center_2D: geometric projection through P of the 3D pupil-disk center (no refraction); the refraction-aware apparent centroid is under extended
